en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Misma’a, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has sad:
‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a tooth of a child before it extrudes, with a camel, a camel regarding each tooth’.
